The man, wearing a leather jacket, crouches down to interact with the toddler who is walking toward him. (4) The woman is seen in a clothing store with shelves of boots in the background, wearing a grey fuzzy sweater and making a peace sign. The child is eating with a spoon, and the man uses chopsticks. The setting is clean and casual. A brief shot of a luxury spa interior with brown leather reclining chairs is included. (10) Product showcase for 'BAUM' perfume, highlighting the bottle with a distinctive round wooden cap. The man is shown spraying the perfume on his wrist and neck in a room with neutral walls. (11) Text-heavy frames list tax-free shop locations in Japan against a blurred background of the perfume bottle and park scenery. (12) In a darkened room, the toddler points at a small projection of an axolotl on the wall while the man watches. (13) The final shot shows the family of three sitting together outdoors at night in front of a shopping mall, clapping their hands in celebration.
